title: Tashkent Rising Again
author: Sable Eastwick
blurb: Hazel Underhill, a whistle-blower living under four names, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must extract a defector who may be the bait, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
